title: What a reused EHR-derived patient label can support: a claim-specific specification illustrated with a sepsis partition
description: Code-only research software for a claim-specific specification illustrated with one sepsis partition. Includes post hoc temperature-source correction, Base + K2 updating, verified reconstruction and corrected-temperature external evaluation of Raw-EN/Raw-RF using the archived L2 recipe, current paired comparisons, held-out recalibration, hospital funnel and missing-pattern transfer. Model evaluation uses R 4.6.0; unchanged figure calculations use R 4.5.3. Restricted data, fitted objects, result tables, figure datasets and execution logs are excluded.
